season.evidence: Stored Jul-Oct; trail database lists Jun-Oct snow-free; SummitPost/WTA mention lingering snow into early summer; log histogram peaks Jul-Sep with Oct still busy; a late-May 2026 report exists but is out of season.

track.why: Only one route is stored on the peak. Logged route Pinnacle Peak TH; track starts 9 m from our trailhead pin and ends 25 m away, summit 8 m, 3.4 mi round trip and about 1,480 ft gain matching our description; July 13 is in season.

otherTracksConsidered.why: July 19 2026 but report says it was peak 3 of a day with Lane and Denman, so possibly a link-up.
Sept 20 2026, complete, no report; second choice.
Traverse from Pinnacle over three peaks in late June; link-up.

facts.text: Biting flies can be bad on the summit in mid-July; stepping to the wind side of the top keeps them off.
Beyond the end of the maintained trail a worn climbers' path leads most of the way up, with little true scrambling.

notes: Report-based facts are thin. Dense cloud in early October (one report) can remove views entirely.
